AWARD WINNING HEADPHONESWinner of the CES Innovation Award 2021, BuddyPhones are recognized as the top safe headphones for children, known for their innovative design and features. PERFECT FOR YOUNG KIDS & BIG KIDSBuddyPhones School+ are designed to fit kids between the ages of 5 to 12. The kids headphones are foldable & adjustable, fitting pleasantly. Ear cups are made with hypoallergenic, durable materials, comfortable for all day wear. Let your child personalize their headphones with various decorative stickers included, featuring fun characters and patterns. Kids can decorate their headphones to their hearts’ delight, making them their uniquely theirs. AWARD-WINNING SAFE AUDIO® FOR KIDS - PROTECTS YOUNG EARSProtecting young ears is a top priority with Safe Audio®. According to the Journal of Pediatrics, "12.5% of kids between the ages of 6 and 19 suffer from hearing loss as a result of using earphones turned to a high volume". That's why these Bluetooth kids headphones come with built-in volume control that keeps your child’s hearing safe. You can choose from three sound levels—75dB, 85dB, or 94dB—to make sure the volume never gets too loud. EXCEPTIONAL EDUCATIONAL TOOLTo help with the growing demand for online classes or home study, School+ Wireless headphones include a high quality detachable boom microphone and our patented Study Mode. This sound enhancing mode filters and clarifies audio voices so they’re easier to understand. Our patented BuddyLink system allows listeners to share audio - ideal for in school settings or with educational Apps. Access the call, playback and volume controls easily and remotely from the built-in buttons on the back of the ear cups. BUILT TO LAST - PARENT APPROVEDBuddyPhones headphones are tough enough for everyday rough play. Parents love that kids can toss, pull, and stretch them without damage. Durable, reliable, and designed for active lifestyles, these kid headphones are a smart, long-lasting choice for kids. MADE WITH WORRY-FREE MATERIALSWe go beyond safety with our SafeAudio® volume-limiting technology by carefully selecting materials that are safe for children. We use only BPA- and phthalate-free plastics, ensuring your child avoids exposure to harmful chemicals found in many plastics. BUDDIES FOR LIFEBuddyPhones are engineered constructed and tested for robustness capable of withstanding even the roughest handling by kids. Our quality control process includes testing at world-class labs to ensure durability.
